report_name: CISA to Finalize CIRCIA Cyber Incident Reporting Rule in Sept 2026

identities.name: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA)
identities.description: The U.S. government agency responsible for issuing and enforcing the Cyber Incident Reporting for Critical Infrastructure Act (CIRCIA) final rule, which establishes mandatory reporting requirements for organizations within 16 designated critical infrastructure sectors.
